title: Graham Hancock's text doubting the Giza SAR source
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Graham Hancock's text doubting the Giza SAR source, about 2025 at Giza plateau, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I texted Graham Hancock about it. He said, "I have no reason to um believe that the source here is being honest."

plain: In 2025 a researcher named Filippo Biondi was putting forward radar scans of the Giza pyramids in Egypt. The scans used SAR, short for synthetic aperture radar, a way of building pictures from radar signals. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he texted Graham Hancock, a writer on lost ancient civilisations, to ask about it. According to Michels, Hancock wrote back that he had "no reason to believe that the source here is being honest", which matters because the scans would point to hidden structures under the pyramids if they hold up.
